WITH per_transaction AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_transaction
), kept AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg
  FROM per_transaction AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg
), scored AS (
  SELECT transref,
         avg_anlycount,
         avg_anlycount - overall_avg AS above_overall,
         avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_kept_avg
  FROM kept
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC) AS result_rank
  FROM scored
)
SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, above_kept_avg
FROM ranked
WHERE result_rank <= 10
ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with no non-NULL anlycount have a NULL average and are excluded; the overall and kept averages are computed across transaction averages, with SQLite AVG ignoring NULLs.
